sources.label: Personal patch bundle for Morphe
sources.author: dieroboter
patch_list: Disables the Google UMP ad-consent flow: the SDK's consent request returns immediately, so no consent information is requested and no consent form is ever loaded or shown.
Makes AppMetrica.activateReporter a no-op, so the AppMetrica reporter the Yandex mediation glue sets up is never activated and its events are dropped.
Disables the in-app rate-us prompts (the SDK's rate-dialog source gate always returns false) and hides the 'Rate us' row in the settings screen.
Prevents the Singular analytics SDK from initializing: its only init call site (the PremiumHelper Singular manager coroutine) returns immediately.

Disables the Toto server-driven config/offers backend: its app-start initialization, config reporting (including the background worker), FCM promotional-push token registration and the worker scheduling all become no-ops.
Hides the 'VIP Customer Support', 'Rate us' and 'Share app' rows in the settings screen, and the rate button on the home screen bar. The support button on the home screen is not affected.
Removes the ad identifier permissions (AD_ID and the Ad Services permissions: ad ID, attribution and topics) from the manifest.

Unlocks premium: forces the PremiumHelper SDK's isPremium check to always return true, which also suppresses banner/interstitial ads and the paywall and relaunch offers through the SDK's own premium paths.
